results.controlIntent: Form a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail by compiling audit records from [Assignment: organization-defined system components], time-correlated to within [Assignment: organization-defined level of tolerance for the relationship between time stamps of individual records in the audit trail].

judgment.rationale:
AU-12(1).v4 requires a system-wide audit trail compiled from multiple components and time-correlated across those sources. Two critical failures are observed:

1. **Broken correlation for the hotfix deployment**: The CloudTrail UpdateEndpoint event (2026-03-15T14:22:00Z, event ID 2a6d7ce5) references endpoint config "churn-predictor-v1-hotfix" but has no corresponding model registry entry. This means the audit trail cannot be correlated across CloudTrail and the SageMaker Model Registry for this change — a direct violation of the control's requirement to compile records from all relevant system components.

2. **Temporal/sequencing anomaly on initial deployment**: The CreateEndpoint CloudTrail event (2025-12-01T11:00:00Z, event ID 9c133f43) carries an embedded note flagging that the deployment occurred 2 hours *before* registry approval at 09:00. While the raw timestamps show approval at 09:00 and deployment at 11:00 (correct order), the internal note indicates a discrepancy or documentation inconsistency that undermines confidence in the integrity of the time-correlated audit trail.

Together, these findings demonstrate that the audit trail is incomplete and not reliably correlated across system components (CloudTrail + Model Registry) for all deployment lifecycle events, failing the core requirement of AU-12(1).v4.
gaps: No model registry entry exists for the 'churn-predictor-v1-hotfix' endpoint config used in the March 2026 UpdateEndpoint event — human attestation or additional registry search needed to confirm whether this was intentionally unregistered.
The internal note on the CreateEndpoint event contradicts the raw timestamps; a CloudWatch Logs or VPC Flow Log cross-reference would help resolve whether a timestamp integrity issue exists.
No evidence of a centralized log aggregation or SIEM system was available to confirm whether time-correlation tolerances are formally defined and enforced across components.

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
